manifest.name: dsh-github-mcp
manifest.description: GitHub official MCP server bridge for DeepSeek Harness: registers mcp__github__* native tools via @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, plus a github_file_read tool that reads file contents over REST (fills the gap where the MCP bridge discards resource content).

bundle.text:
# cordis.patch.yml — GitHub official MCP server bridge + REST file reader.
#
# Installed via:  dsh plugin --profile web add github:GitRuozhi/dsh-github-mcp
#
# Two plugin rows:
#   1. mcp-github       — bridges the official github/github-mcp-server (remote
#                         mode, api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/) into mcp__github__*
#                         native tools via @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client.
#   2. github-file-read — registers github_file_read, a REST-backed file/dir
#                         reader returning decoded text. It exists because
#                         dsh-mcp-client discards MCP resource content, so
#                         get_file_contents can't return file bodies.
#
# Both read GITHUB_TOKEN from process.env (materialized from $DSH_HOME/.env).

- insert:
    - id: mcp-github
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: github
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
        headers:
          Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN}`'
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000
        failOnStartupError: false

    - id: github-file-read
      name: dsh-github-mcp
      config: {}

readme.text:
DSH-GitHub bridge: exposes the official GitHub MCP server as DSH-native tools, and fixes the issue where DSH's bridge discards file content.

After install, the agent can reach GitHub and read files directly through the `mcp__github__*` tool family and the `github_file_read` tool — no local Git or `gh` CLI in between.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GitRuozhi/dsh-github-mcp
```

Set `GITHUB_TOKEN` and restart `dsh web`. If `gh` is already logged in on this machine, you can just ask DSH to configure it for you.

| | |
|---|---|
| ✅ Official | talks to GitHub's official `github-mcp-server` |
| ✅ Native MCP | speaks MCP directly — no `gh` wrapper, no hand-written REST |
| ✅ Zero local deps | uses GitHub's hosted endpoint `https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/` |
| ✅ Reads file bodies | `github_file_read` fixes the official bridge's dropped-content problem |

Still needed. Rechecked on DeepSeek Harness `0.1.5-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` `0.1.5-rc.2`; upstream `master` is `0.1.6-alpha.1`):

- `mcp__github__get_file_contents` still returns `successfully downloaded text file (SHA: …)` plus `[embedded resource unsupported; raw resource data remains available to programmatic callers]`. The file body never reaches the model.
- `github_file_read` still returns decoded UTF-8 text for the same path.
Official `minimal` inherits these tools (they register globally). A custom preset such as `mini-win` can mask them.

Two tool families are added on install:

**`github_file_read`** — read a file's contents (decoded to UTF-8 text) or list a directory; private repos work too (needs `GITHUB_TOKEN`).

**`mcp__github__*` (44 tools from GitHub's official MCP server)**
> Model-facing names all carry the `mcp__github__` prefix.

This plugin registers its tools globally, so every preset inherits the GitHub tools — including minimal presets. To opt a preset out, filter them from each system-prompt assembly. Note: DSH's built-in `minimal` preset cannot mask global plugins; create your own custom minimal preset instead.
